reviews.title: Deleting Game Because The Developers Are Stealing REAL Money Out Of My Pocket
reviews.text:
The neverending glitches are bad enough, but when I buy the season pass or other things, it drives me crazy when, for the third time, the game gets locked because of an ad that gets stuck and my progress is erased. The last couple of times, it was the oreillyauto. com ad. Progress completely erased and I lost 25 keys using the 3X feature. I’m going to see if I can lodge a complaint with Apple (yeah, I know that won’t go anywhere) but I want my complaint to exist in writing.

UPDATE - 9/29/26

I was contacted by Nastsichka regarding what happened. Over the past few days it was suggested it might be an issue with my phone. Then it turned to asking me for my player ID, which I sent screenshots TWICE! Now, it “we need your device model and your 0S info and is it just the oreilly ads. I’m not the only person complaining about the numerous glitches in both games but I feel like this is just going to keep spinning in circles; that the developers are deliberately wasting my time, and won’t go anywhere in the end. I’m over this and done jumping through this hoop. I’ve deleted both games. If you download this game, you do so at your own risk, but don’t buy anything. It’s just you throwing money away.

reviews.title: For the long haul! (And then some)
reviews.text:
I got into this shortly after playing the OG subway surfers, and I can easily say that this is a second favorite when it comes to my library of games that I currently have. From the revamped/original characters and boards that go with each character to the daily events and other things in between and also all the locations that are lockable while there are only a few, they are definitely diverse from downtown Subway City to the national Park vibe of DeLorean Park to the mysterious underground labyrinth of the undertracks there’s definitely a lot of variety and even though there’s a paywall to quite a few things, the good news is once you make a payment on anything the forced ads are immediately removed, though you will still have to watch ads to get a better rewards also the subway pass for each season while it is a little steep for some. It is reasonably priced with all the stuff that comes with it. This is definitely worth picking up even if you haven’t played Subway surfers before. There’s no excuse to say no at least here.

-The Toon critic 

P.S. 

A few things I do recommend if the devs Are seeing this

1. Adding more characters from the OG Subway surfers such as Catherine from the rival season as well as the rest of the rivals cast a few others I can think of for Audrey from the Sydney season Tony from New York as well as rain from New York pride month as well as boards to go along with them along with whoever else you can think of

2. Adding more districts here’s a few ideas that I came up with:

1. A skate park to go with the skating theme.

2. An industrial Park with businesses and what not.

3. A transit terminal to go with the subway theme that is abundant in the game.

4. A construction site of some kind of similar to the docks.

5. A historic downtown with a Townhall and such (the Townhall is something you can go into similar to the natural history museum in DeLorean Park)

3. Adding more unique outfits for all the surfers I don’t know of any of the top of my head but if you have any ideas, please. make. it. happen.

reviews.title: HIGH SCORE GONEEE
reviews.text: Hi! I absolutely love the new game it has given me all the nostalgia! But…the last 2 times that I’ve played, the game has glitched mid game after I have beat my high score and the app crashed! When I went back into the app, it said I was under my original high score by under 100K. I thought maybe it was just my phone but it froze again mid game again today after I reached over 500K! I wouldn’t have been so upset but I worked my butt off for that score lol. So I took a screenshot of what my high score was (before the app crashed) and it was 540,847 and then I went back into the app, and now it says 477,413. Just wanted to bring this to your attention as I loved the game when it came out when I was a child! But no harm at all!! Thanks!

reviews.title: Surfing A.D.S. 🛹
reviews.text: I found Subway Surfers City after logging back in to the original — Subway Surfers. That original game was littered with forced advertisements, way too many events going on, and an overall crowded user interface. I’m happy to say that Subway Surfers City is, overall, a great improvement and updated version of that classic to mobile gaming. The art style pays homage while making it look sleeker at the same time! There are some new fun mechanics, unlocking new areas to run through is fun, and the city tour mode is decent! What really holds this back from being a modern day classic, are the ads. Obviously, no one loves ads but for a free-to-play game there needs to be some way to make money back. I can understand that through the option of paying for in-game currency, and maybe some other cosmetics, but overall paying for something in a game has always thrown me off. Especially with the season pass system. Thankfully, most characters and boards can be unlocked through time playing. It just becomes hard to strongly recommend the game when after every few runs you have to sit through a forced ad. Watching one for an extra life, for special loot, that’s fine. But the more ads feel forced down your throat (same with the “deals” to buy more in-game content) the less fun coming back to play feels. I also would love it if the main interface when you log into the game were cleaner, less messy with all of these buttons. Let the ambiance of the characters skating in the city take center stage rather than all of these pop-ups crowding the screen just like now in the original game.
